tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government Government of India Union Territory
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee into the respective receiving bank accounts of e Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
EMD Payments through e-payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection
Amount put tender is Minimum basic wages VDA EPF ESI the agency should bid to this amount for service charges only Negative percentage is not allowed
If the agency quotes for Negative percentage for service charges tender will be rejected
The agency should quote the rate in Percentage above the amount put to tender or else tender will be rejected
If there are more than 01 number of eligible L1 bidder then bidder selection will be done by lottery process at division office level. And decision of the inviting authority is final in this regard
As per the availability of above posts Executive Engineer will have the power of reducing the Manpower labours without any notice
The GST will be levied as per the prevailing Tax structure, Amount put to tender is exclusive of GST
The Tenderer should submit every months Electronic Challan cum receipt ECR of EPF ESI bills challan along with bilS
Any violation of Labour department rules and norms the agency is hold responsible
As per the availability of above posts Executive Engineer will have the power or reduction ofthe Manpower labours without any notice
Mandatory contribution of EPF and ESIC by the agencies in timely manner
The service provider contractor shall be responsible for paying wages to contract labour at rates not less than the minimum wages as noticed by the Appropriate Government
The service provider contractor shall not make any unauthorized deductions from the wages of the contract labour

As per the Contract Labour Regulation and Abolition Act 1970 the service providercontractor shall be responsible for ensuring that wages are paid to the contract labour on time The principal employer buyer shall ensure that the wages are paid on time to the contract labour by the service provider contractor In case the service provider contractor fails to pay the wages on time or makes short payment the principal employer buyer shall be liable to pay the wages to the contract labour directly and recover the amount from the service provider contractor
The service provider contractor shall be responsible for paying bonus to contract labour in the manner prescribed by the Payment of Bonus Act 1965 shall get reimbursed from the buyer
The service provider contractor shall be responsible for paying proportionate gratuity to contract labour who have rendered continuous service as per the provisions of the Payment Gratuity Act 1972
The agency should make the payment to the manpower employees supplied every month and submit the bills for reimbursement in the first week of every month along with Attendance of manpower employee

The Electronic document i.e. Financial bid of all the participated bidder will be opened after approval of the technical bidqualification among eligible bidders the lowest bidder will be identified. If the lowest bidder fails to produce the original documents for entering into an agreement or the original documents submitted does not match with the uploaded documents or found false, then his bid is treated as non-responsive bid as per clause-26/4 of the KTPP rules & his name would be recommended for the removal from the select list of KPWD enrolment and barred from participation in any of the tenders invited by the VJNL apart from forfeiting the EMD paid through e-cash
all other conditions as per tender documents

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All other conditions as per Notification & Tender documents
Attested copy of EPF registration certificate and certificate from Regional Provident fund Commissioner regarding successful payment of EPF for the year 2024-25 and 2025-26
Attested copy of ESI Registration certificate and certificate from ESI Deputy Director regarding successful payment of ESI for the year 2024-25 and 2025-26
Attested copy of Professional tax registration certificate, Teeruvali certificate for the year 2024-25 and 2025-26.
Enclose copy of GST Registration certificate of agency/organization and enclose latest copy of monthly GST returns
I.T Return for the Financial Year 2024-25
Name of the contractor, office phone, fax, and mobile number, Email ID, and firm fully address

Scanned signature of the bidder / authorized representative in case of the firm or company be attached while uploading the bid documents. Also in case of authorized representative, scanned copy of power of attorney should be uploaded

The intending bidder should have in the last 5 years achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs.18.74 Lakhs Audited balance sheet certified by the chartered Accountant of two financial years in which required turnover is achieved along with IT returns filed for the said years are to be uploaded. An additional weightage of 10 percent per year will be added to bring it to the present price level

The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least 90percent of the Contract Value as a prime contractor at least one similar nature of work such as Supply of manpower service costing not less than Rs.9.50 Lakhs. here value of contract implies final cost of work executed as per contract during last 5 years
Valid Registration in Labour Department Attested copy of form C registration certificate from labour department The firm should enclose current year valid certificate
